Plot a dicom_volume Object

Source: R/dicom-volume.R
plot.dicom_volume.Rd

Visualizes a 3D/4D dicom_volume as a 3-plane orthogonal Multi-Planar Reconstruction (method = "mpr") or Maximum Intensity Projection (method = "mip") via render_volume(), or renders a single 2D slice via ggdicom() when dim(x)[3] == 1 or slice is specified.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dicom_volume'
plot(
  x,
  y = NULL,
  ...,
  slice = NULL,
  method = c("mpr", "mip", "rgl"),
  window = "auto",
  threshold = 0.5,
  palette = c("gray", "viridis", "inferno", "magma", "plasma"),
  frame = 1L
)

Arguments

x

A dicom_volume object.

y

Unused (included for S3 generic compatibility with base::plot()). If supplied as a single numeric value while slice is NULL, treated as slice.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggdicom() for single-slice rendering (e.g. center, width, annotate, title).

slice

Optional 1-based integer slice index to plot a single 2D slice.

method

Volume rendering mode when plotting 3D volumes: "mpr" (default), "mip", or "rgl".

window

Window preset ("auto", "brain", "lung", "bone", etc.) or c(center, width). Default is "auto".

threshold

Intensity threshold in [0, 1] when method = "rgl". Default is 0.5.

palette

Color palette ("gray", "viridis", "inferno", "magma", "plasma"). Default is "gray".

frame

1-based temporal frame index when x is a 4D volume. Default is 1L.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object (or invisibly the rgl scene ID when method = "rgl" and rgl is installed).

Examples

vox <- array(seq_len(12 * 12 * 4), dim = c(12L, 12L, 4L))
vol <- new_dicom_volume(vox, affine = diag(c(0.8, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0)), modality = "CT")
plot(vol, method = "mpr")

plot(vol, slice = 2L)
